title: 第3章 任务多多第4章 反杀！
content_zh:
第三章任务多多
“好，好，”白袍老者看着叶宇轩顽强的意志，缓缓的站了起来，大声赞叹道
在叶宇轩眼中，原本距离自己十丈距离的老者。忽然出现在自己的面前。十丈的距离转瞬即逝，只在空中留下数到残影。看着眼前的老者，叶宇轩额头上的汗水更多了。但已经受了重伤的叶宇轩此时根本无法移动，只能眼睁睁的看着老者。
突然，戏剧化的一面出现了，冷漠的老者脸上露出了几丝欣慰缓缓道：“勇士，你很好。不错，不错。这是给你的，喝下去，你就会好的。”一瓶红色的药水凭空出现在老者的手上，缓缓的递给叶宇轩。
没有丝毫的犹豫，叶宇轩接过了药水。经历了刚才的事情，叶宇轩此刻已经知道，老者要杀自己就像捏死一只蚂蚁那么简单，既然如此，现在又怎么会浪费一瓶药水来害自己呢？
快速的喝下药水，叶宇轩只觉得一股暖流传遍全身。麻木的右手立即恢复了知觉。自己的状态好似又恢复到了顶峰。
叶宇轩满脑疑惑的看着老者，不明白为什么自己明明被他一击击败了，却还说自己“很好，不错，”还给自己恢复身体的药水喝。
“有什么疑问可以提出来，”老者看着叶宇轩充满疑惑的双眼，冷漠中带着一丝温暖的说道。
“我想知道，我一没有打败你，二没有坚持一分钟，您为什么说我很好，不错，还给我药水，治疗身体呢？”
“恩，你确实两样都没有做到，但是首先违规的是我，当年一拳打来的时候，感受到你的拳风，不自觉的用出了5成力量，如果是用一成，那么以你刚才的一击已经赢了。”老者有些尴尬的说道。
“额，”听完老者的回答，叶宇轩彻底无语了。
“好了，现在你通过了我的试炼，可以为我服务了，不知你是否愿意。”老者感受着周围尴尬的气氛，扯开话题道。
“愿意，”虽然老者口中的服务二字听在叶宇轩的耳中非常的别扭，但是和生存、信念相比起来。一切都可以不与之计较。
“好，好，小子，我看你根骨奇佳，又有着优良的品质。决定收你做我的入门弟子是否愿意。”冷漠的老人第一次笑着说道。
“愿，愿意。”看着老人嘴角处，微微崛起的弧度，一股不详的预感笼罩在叶宇轩的心头。
“叮叮，”手表突然震动起来。叶宇轩，叶宇轩没有犹豫选择了确定。
“选中者（假）666666选择接受武师雷卡的考验，消灭毒蜘蛛010。”
在这个村庄的东北方向有着一片茂密的森林，里面群居着一群变异的毒蜘蛛。只要你消灭了十只，并且准备1000积分就算通过了我的考验！去吧，勇者！”说完之后，老者双眼鼓励之色一闪而过，再次闭上了眼睛。
敏锐的叶宇轩捕捉到了那丝鼓励，心中升起一丝温暖。见他又闭起了双眼，嘴角撅起一个小小的弧度，知道了他是一个外冷，内热的人。便识趣的走出了武馆。却发现武馆的空地上刷新了一个手持木棒的稻草人。
有心试试自己的实力到底这么样的叶宇轩。快速奔上前去，手起剑落，那反应超慢的稻草人毫无疑问的被叶宇轩快剑击中，同时还微微的后仰了一下。给人一种差点要跌倒的感觉。

一秒钟过后才反应过来，狠狠的举起手中的木棒向着叶宇轩挥去。看着那迟缓的速度，叶宇轩双脚猛的向旁边一蹬，整个身体一侧，轻松躲过，右手一挥，一道寒光闪过。只见倾斜中的稻草人微微一顿，
看了眼自己的生命才知道减少了一点。259260
然后化成了一阵青烟消失在空气之中。地上留下了一小堆金币！
“这只3级的稻草人，我打它，可以算得上是轻而易举，那么以我现在的实力杀10级的半兽人，15级的半兽人勇士，还有20级的bss半兽人统领又会这么样呢？叶宇轩一边思考一边捡起了地上的东西。
“你获得了金币10！可兑换积分10！”
叶宇轩并没有放弃其他的地方，将整个村庄都转了一圈。发现了一个武器店和一个药店。武器店中，叶宇轩吃惊的发现这里面的武器都需要极高的属性和积分。例如八荒，需要26点力量，和4000点积分。就连乌木剑也需要15点力量，12点智力。这么高的属性，如果不是新手关，系统使得每个试炼者自身属性全部乘以2，真不知道有几人可以带上。而且还要1500积分。
看着自己一个都买不起的武器，叶宇轩提着下巴，做出一副沉思之状，缓缓着道：“铁匠师傅，你有什么需要帮助的吗，我可以为你效劳！”
“哦，年轻的勇士，你来的正是时候，我需要的锻造武器使用的白银矿石没有了。你可以帮我找10个回来吗？我将给予你丰厚的报酬
“荣幸之至。”叶宇轩听到丰厚的报酬几个字，双眼立即闪烁出异样的光芒，随即隐去，礼貌道。
“选中者（假）666666选择接受铁匠欧飞的任务，去比奇矿洞挖到10个品质5以上包括5的白银矿石回来。
又接到一个，叶宇轩原本悲伤的内心，终于稍稍愉悦，不急不缓的奔向村中最后一间房屋。
“尊敬的药师大人，请问有什么需要我帮助的吗？”叶宇轩恭敬的说道。
“我需要一些食人花的树叶和果实做药材，你能够帮助我寻找一些吗？”
“是。”
“选中者（假）666666选择接受药师萧峰的委托。去森林中寻找食人花树叶06,果实04。”
再三确定接完了这里所有任务的叶宇轩，快速的向着城外走去，出了城门，映入叶宇轩眼帘的是：熙熙攘攘的站着十几个人正在砍杀着稻草人和钉耙猫。他们三个一群，五个一组，显然都已经组成了小队。
content_en:
Chapter 3: Lots of tasks
"Okay, okay," the old man in white robe looked at Ye Yuxuan's tenacious will, stood up slowly, and praised loudly
In Ye Yuxuan's eyes, the old man was originally ten feet away from him. Suddenly appeared in front of him. The distance of ten feet disappeared in an instant, leaving only a few afterimages in the air. Looking at the old man in front of him, Ye Yuxuan sweated even more on his forehead. But Ye Yuxuan, who had been seriously injured, could not move at all at this time and could only watch the old man helplessly.
Suddenly, the dramatic side appeared, and the indifferent old man showed a bit of relief on his face and said slowly: "Warrior, you are fine. Not bad, not bad. This is for you, drink it, and you will be fine." A bottle of red potion appeared out of thin air in the old man's hand, and he slowly handed it to Ye Yuxuan.
Without the slightest hesitation, Ye Yuxuan took the potion. After what happened just now, Ye Yuxuan already knew that killing him was as simple as crushing an ant. In that case, how could he waste a bottle of potion to harm himself now?
After drinking the potion quickly, Ye Yuxuan felt a warmth spread throughout his body.麻木的右手立即恢复了知觉。 His condition seemed to be back to its peak again.
Ye Yuxuan looked at the old man with confusion, wondering why he said he was "very good, not bad" even though he was defeated by him with one blow, and even gave him the potion to restore his body.
"If you have any questions, you can ask them," the old man said with a hint of warmth in his indifference, looking at Ye Yuxuan's doubtful eyes.
"I want to know, firstly, I didn't defeat you, and secondly, I didn't last a minute. Why did you say that I was very good, not bad, and why did you give me potions to heal my body?"
"Well, you did neither, but I was the one who broke the rules in the first place. When I punched you, I felt your punch and unconsciously used 50% of your strength. If it was 10%, then you had already won with the punch you just delivered." The old man said with some embarrassment.
"Uh," Ye Yuxuan was completely speechless after hearing the old man's answer.
"Okay, now you have passed my trial and can serve me. I wonder if you are willing." The old man felt the awkward atmosphere around him and changed the subject.
"Yes," although the word service in the old man's mouth sounded very awkward to Ye Yuxuan's ears, it was compared with survival and faith.一切都可以不与之计较。
"Okay, okay, boy, I see that you have very good bones and excellent qualities. Do you want to accept you as my first disciple?" The cold old man said with a smile for the first time.
"I wish, I wish." Looking at the slightly rising arc at the corner of the old man's mouth, an unknown premonition enveloped Ye Yuxuan's heart.
"Ding ding," the watch suddenly vibrated. Ye Yuxuan, Ye Yuxuan chose to confirm without hesitation.
"The chosen one (fake) 666666 chose to accept the test of martial artist Reka and destroy the poisonous spider 010."
There is a dense forest to the northeast of this village, in which a group of mutated poisonous spiders live. As long as you kill ten of them and prepare 1,000 points, you will pass my test! Go, brave man! "After he finished speaking, the old man's eyes flashed with encouragement and he closed his eyes again.
The keen Ye Yuxuan caught that hint of encouragement, and a warmth rose in his heart. Seeing that he closed his eyes again, and the corners of his mouth curled up in a small arc, he knew that he was a person who was cold on the outside but hot on the inside.便识趣的走出了武馆。 However, a scarecrow holding a wooden stick appeared in the open space of the martial arts hall.
Ye Yuxuan was determined to test his own strength. He quickly ran forward, raised his sword and lowered his hand. The scarecrow, who reacted very slowly, was undoubtedly hit by Ye Yuxuan's fast sword, and at the same time, he leaned back slightly.给人一种差点要跌倒的感觉。
It took a second to react, and he raised the wooden stick in his hand and swung it at Ye Yuxuan.Seeing the sluggish speed, Ye Yuxuan kicked his feet to the side, and easily avoided it with his whole body. He waved his right hand and a cold light flashed through. I saw the leaning scarecrow pause slightly.
When I looked at my life, I realized that it had decreased a little. 259260
Then it turned into a puff of smoke and disappeared into the air. A small pile of gold coins was left on the ground!
"This level 3 scarecrow can be easily beaten by me. So with my current strength, what will happen if I kill a level 10 orc, a level 15 orc warrior, and a level 20 boss orc commander? Ye Yuxuan picked up something on the ground while thinking.
"You got 10 gold coins! 10 redeemable points! "
Ye Yuxuan did not give up other places and turned around the entire village. Found a weapons shop and a pharmacy. In the weapons store, Ye Yuxuan was surprised to find that the weapons in the store required extremely high attributes and points. For example, Bahuang requires 26 strength points and 4,000 points. Even the ebony sword requires 15 points of strength and 12 points of intelligence. With such high attributes, if it is not a new level, the system will multiply all the attributes of each trialist by 2. I really don’t know how many people can bring it. And it also costs 1,500 points.
Looking at the weapons that he could not afford to buy, Ye Yuxuan raised his chin, looked thoughtful, and said slowly: "Master blacksmith, do you need any help? I can help you! "
"Oh, young warrior, you came at the right time. The silver ore I need to forge weapons is gone. Can you find 10 of them for me? I will give you generous rewards
"It's an honor." When Ye Yuxuan heard the words "generous reward," his eyes immediately flashed with a strange light, and then he disappeared and said politely.
"The chosen one (fake) 666666 chose to accept the task of blacksmith Ou Fei, go to Beech Mine and dig out 10 silver ores with quality 5 or above, including 5.
After receiving another one, Ye Yuxuan's originally sad heart finally felt a little happy, and he ran towards the last house in the village unhurriedly.
"Dear Medicine Master, may I help you in any way? "Ye Yuxuan said respectfully.
“I need some piranha leaves and fruits for medicinal purposes, can you help me find some? "
"yes. "
"The chosen one (fake) 666666 chose to accept the commission from pharmacist Xiao Feng. Go to the forest to find Piranha Leaf 06 and Fruit 04. "
Ye Yuxuan, who repeatedly confirmed that he had completed all the tasks here, quickly walked out of the city. After exiting the city gate, what caught Ye Yuxuan's eyes was: a dozen people standing bustling and killing the scarecrow and the rake cat. They were in groups of three and five, and they had obviously formed a team.
